Spring Greens with Radish and Buttermilk Dressing

★★★★★4.7 (418)

Crisp lettuces, peppery radishes and a cool, tangy dressing that clings to every leaf.

SMRecipe by Sofia Marchetti · Tested in the Larder kitchen
Jump to recipe

A good salad is mostly about contrast: soft leaves and crunchy radishes, sharp dressing and sweet herbs.

The recipe

Prep15 min
Cook0 min
Total15 min
Serves4

Ingredients 4 servings

For the salad

For the dressing

Method

  1. Whisk the dressing

    Whisk the buttermilk, mayonnaise and mustard with a pinch of salt and plenty of pepper.

    2 min
  2. Dress and serve

    Toss the leaves and radishes with half the dressing, scatter with chives and seeds, and pass the rest at the table.

Keep it crisp: dress the salad at the very last moment.
